descriptions.notStarted: Do you know Rolonay, the smartest genius alive in all of The Nautilus? He is possibly the smartest person in all of Maple World. But he's apparently stuck in a jam, because of all the requests he's been getting from people asking for more and more information. I'd better give Rolonay a hand- But first, I should go see him in the central corridors of The Nautilus.
descriptions.inProgress: Rolonay's been working hard to compile all the information #bDr. Kim#k had requested, but says he's too tied up with all the analysis he has to do, to bring the research documents all the way to the Omega Sector. I should help out Rolonay and bring all the research documents to the Omega Sector for him.
descriptions.completed: I've delivered all the research documents to Dr. Kim, on Rolonay's behalf. That Rolonay, despite his looks, is quite a brainiac!
